explication: agent-browser is a Rust browser-automation CLI for AI agents, with typed MCP access and live browser streaming. The main workflow is an agent invoking CLI commands to launch/connect to a browser, perform page actions, and receive snapshots or other results. The README establishes the user-facing capabilities; source-index references and sampled excerpts support selected internal links. Unsampled subsystems are represented where documented, but their internal call paths are not inferred.
